title: Using blocks with discipline; time on the bass drum; Mac Murray's lesson
summary: Foster explains varying breaks, keeping time with the feet while the hands make 'monkeyshines', and recalls Mac Murray's advice at Lincoln Park that the bass drum makes or breaks a band.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
